Container.Name: hivemind
Container.Overview:
HiveMind lets several AI models work together on a drag-and-drop canvas, and you watch them think.
Chain local Ollama models and cloud AIs (OpenRouter free models, Groq, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, any OpenAI-compatible API) into teams: models answer, review each other anonymously, debate or vote, and a judge merges the best final answer. Every step streams live with GPU loading bars, tokens, speed and cost.
Also: images with your own ComfyUI, web search, files and website previews, memory, a Builder AI that designs canvases from one sentence, voice in and out, Home Assistant / webhook / Discord action blocks, an OpenAI-compatible API (every canvas is a model) with a Home Assistant integration, users with admin / user / viewer roles, cost and speed stats with a model leaderboard, and run export to Markdown, JSON or PDF.
One container, everything in /data (SQLite). Open the WebUI and create the admin account; the setup wizard does the rest.
Container.Requires: Optional: an Ollama container (or any machine running Ollama) for local models, and ComfyUI for local images. Cloud AIs only need an API key; several have free tiers.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface and the API (http://[IP]:port/v1 for OpenAI-compatible apps). If you change the container side, set PORT to the same number.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database (canvases, runs, users, settings), the files folder (uploads, images, saved answers) and the generated secret key. Back this up.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Your Ollama server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434 (use the LAN IP, not localhost). Added as the first AI provider on the first start; change it later in Settings → AI providers. Leave empty to use only cloud AIs.

Config.Name: ComfyUI URL
Config.Description: Optional: your ComfyUI, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8188. Its checkpoints and LoRAs become local image models for Image blocks. Added once; manage it later in Settings.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: true when you open HiveMind over HTTPS (e.g. behind Nginx Proxy Manager or SWAG). HTTPS also lets browsers use the microphone for voice input.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Optional. Encrypts stored API keys and tokens (AES-256-GCM). Empty = one is generated once and kept in /data/secret.key. If you set it, never lose or change it: saved keys can't be read without it.

Config.Name: Internal port
Config.Description: Port HiveMind listens on inside the container. Only change it together with the container side of Web port.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: How much the container log shows. Problems are always also listed in the Problems tab.
